proof: Proper stable labeled compression adds stability to proper labeled compression. Restricting the allowed compression functions cannot decrease the minimum size.
name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / Proper Labeled Sample Compression
witness_verification: On the singleton class, proper stable labeled compression is at least $\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil$ and at most $n-1$, while proper labeled compression is one for $n\ge2$. Thus no reverse affine bound is possible. These are database-owned endpoint values, checked by sync/verify_order_stable_compression.py. This supersedes the weaker full-cube witness, where the values are both of linear order; the full-cube strict separation and slope-$3/2$ obstruction remain valid as stated in survey cor:compression-nctd-gap.
